features.feature: Sign in… opens the browser and comes back signed in; Sign out forgets the token and the calendar falls back to today's agenda; another app id or tenant can be set
The calendar's week comes from Microsoft 365 without blocking the window
A recorded meeting's chat (and an ad-hoc call's) is kept with the call
Send a test, `deliver send` and routines send only to the user's own Teams chat and mailbox (or a plugin's way)
`echoctl m365` sends nothing without `--yes`: it answers what would be sent
Thread mail and chats are read only from the user, colleagues and trusted, authenticated senders; others wait in the Inbox
